tasks.title: Design the retry policy for failed webhook deliveries
tasks.description: Decide max attempts, backoff shape, and the dead-letter path. Agents are blocked on this decision for the worker implementation.

tasks.title: Implement webhook delivery worker with exponential backoff
tasks.description: Consume the outbox table, deliver with retries per the policy from the design task, emit delivery events for the dashboard.
blockers_by_title: Design the retry policy for failed webhook deliveries

comments.text: Outbox schema and consumer skeleton are ready on a branch. Parking this as BLOCKED until the retry policy lands — the backoff shape changes the consumer loop.

tasks.title: Idempotency keys for the charge endpoint
tasks.description: Double-submits currently create duplicate charges in the sandbox. Key on (account, request hash) with a 24h window.

comments.text: Reproduced the duplicate charge with two concurrent POSTs. Fix in progress: unique index plus a replay of the stored response.
Make sure the replayed response carries the original charge id — the mobile client keys its receipt screen off it.

tasks.title: QA: verify duplicate-charge fix under concurrent load
tasks.description: Hammer the charge endpoint with 50 concurrent identical requests; exactly one charge may land. Verdict goes back on the dev task.
tasks.parent_by_title: Idempotency keys for the charge endpoint

tasks.title: Currency rounding: charge totals off by one cent for JPY
tasks.description: Zero-decimal currencies were divided by 100 twice on the invoice path.

comments.text: Verified against the sandbox for JPY, KRW and VND — totals match the gateway to the unit. Regression test pinned all three.

tasks.title: Refunds dashboard: live status column
tasks.description: Stream refund state changes over SSE instead of the 30s poll, so support sees a refund settle while the customer is still on the call.

tasks.title: Nightly reconciliation batch times out on months with >1M transactions
tasks.description: Batch loads the whole month into memory. Page by settlement day and stream the diff.

comments.text: Backfill re-run kicked off on the staging replica (~40 min). Parked on that run; the watcher flips this back when the process exits.

tasks.title: Intermittent 502 from the sandbox gateway
tasks.description: Seen twice on Tuesday, none since; no pattern in the gateway logs.

comments.text: 600 requests across three hours, zero failures. Closing as not reproducible; reopen with a request id if it comes back.
